verdict.rationale: AiPrise documents automated analysis that produces insights inside the product: website risk-signal review, pinpointing which document field was altered, alert adjudication, and CLEAN/FRAUD verdicts with evidence attached. Its docs also brand it an AI-powered platform. These are fixed, compliance-specific outputs, and the AI nature of each feature is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation that insights are AI-generated, open-ended insights or suggestions over the user's broader data (e.g., an assistant or recommendations surface), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Reviews a business's website for risk signals automatically
it shows you exactly which field was edited and what the original said
Screens against watchlists and adjudicates alerts
returns a CLEAN or FRAUD verdict with the evidence attached
